name: observation_id
description: Deterministic hash of the key fields (see secondwind/core/observations.py); MERGE key

name: source
description: Integration that delivered the row (garmin, healthkit, calculated, ...)

name: origin_app
description: App that wrote the value into an aggregator (HealthKit / Health Connect)

name: origin_device
description: Device model as reported

name: device_id
description: -> devices.device_id

name: metric
description: Code from metric_registry, or x.<source>.<path> for unmapped vendor fields

name: method
description: Code from method_registry

name: method_version
description: Vendor algorithm or module version; a change starts a new baseline epoch

name: unit
description: Canonical UCUM unit of the metric

name: value_orig
description: Value as the vendor sent it

name: start_ts
description: UTC

name: end_ts
description: UTC

name: tz_offset_min
description: Local offset from UTC at start_ts

name: local_date
description: Day the value belongs to, see date_rule

name: date_rule
description: wake_date | local_calendar | vendor_day

name: granularity
description: instant | epoch | session | daily | rolling

name: aggregate
description: mean | min | max | sum | last | count

name: context
description: sleep | workout | rest | spot_test | all_day | pre_sleep | environment

name: session_id
description: -> sessions.session_id

name: confidence
description: 0..1 if the vendor reports it

name: calibrating
description: Vendor says the value is still learning the user

name: as_of_ts
description: When this revision of an intraday-changing value was taken

name: vendor_field
description: Path of the value in the vendor payload

name: raw_ref
description: gs:// object (+ #json-pointer) of the raw payload

name: computed_by
description: vendor | secondwind:<module>@<version>

name: derived_from
description: observation_id of the inputs (computed rows)

name: attrs
description: Open metadata: distance_m, zone, sport, vendor qualifiers, ...
